summary: Iteration 5 testing: Billing/Razorpay, Admin dashboard, Cashflow-positive calc, Portfolio vs investments, Trial system, Tour modal, Guide page, Help FAB. All 34 backend tests pass. Frontend fully functional.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' badge (bottom-right fixed element) overlaps the help-fab button and intercepts pointer events. The FAB cannot be clicked in production. In Playwright: 'a#emergent-badge intercepts pointer events'.

issues: data-testid='cashflow-max-price' tile is missing. The max price is displayed in the results section but has no testid attribute.

action_items: Fix Help FAB z-index or position so the Emergent badge does not intercept clicks. Increase z-index above z-40 (currently set) or adjust the FAB position to not overlap the badge. Consider adding pointer-events-none to badge wrapper or moving FAB to bottom-right with enough margin.
Optional: Add data-testid='cashflow-max-price' to the max price tile in CashflowPositiveCalc results for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Help FAB is positioned fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 which conflicts with 'Made with Emergent' badge at the same position. The badge uses pointer-events and overlaps. Needs z-index fix or position adjustment.

Tour AnimatePresence: the Tour component returns null when open=false, so the exit animation from AnimatePresence never fires. While not a functional bug, the AnimatePresence wrapper is unused for unmount animations.
verify-payment uses hmac.new() (correct Python 3 API). No issues found.
Admin self-demote properly blocked. Admin seeding on startup correctly updates existing admin. All billing logic correct.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all features working except Help FAB blocked by Emergent badge overlay

seed_data_creation: Several trial users registered during testing (tour{uid}@test.com, trial_{uid}@test.com, free_{uid}@test.com, reg_{uid}@test.com)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5-iteration backend tests pass. Main outstanding issue is Help FAB blocked by Emergent badge overlay. Pricing page (3 plan cards), Admin dashboard (stats/users/txn tabs), Tour modal (6 steps + skip/close/next/prev), Guide page (FAQs expandable + run tour), Cashflow-positive finder (6-row breakdown table), Trial banner for new users - all working correctly. Razorpay order creation tested and working (order_id returned, amount 99900 for monthly). Signature verification (HMAC SHA-256) tested and working.
rca_of_issue: Help FAB z-index bug: AppShell positions the FAB at 'fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40'. The Emergent badge is an iframe/anchor overlay that also sits at the bottom-right corner with higher or equal z-index, intercepting pointer events. Fix: increase FAB z-index to z-50 or z-[9999], or move the FAB position slightly to avoid overlap (e.g., right-20 or bottom-16).
